title: SQL FCI cert-rotate: one shared cert + single checkpoint
description: The nexus-cli cert-rotate verb for the SQL Server FCI: issue ONE cert from Vault PKI, import it on BOTH FCI nodes, write the single cluster checkpoint, and cycle the SQL resource. A per-node rotate would break failover.

observe.what: both sql-fci-1 + sql-fci-2 report the SAME new serial (the shared cert), old serials differ; 0 errors

whatProves: an FCI checkpoints a single SuperSocketNetLib\\Certificate thumbprint the cluster replicates; cert-rotate issues one shared cert (via the build-host Vault HTTP API + PFX/SFTP, ws2025 has no openssl) so failover stays TLS-valid.
